Matt Turner aids his daughter Deserae Turner, center, a Utah teenage girl who survived being shot in the head by two boys, as they arrive for a news conference, for the first time since she was found in a ditch two months ago Thursday, April 20, 2017, at Primary Children’s Hospital, in Salt Lake City. The Feb. 17 crime shocked residents in the small town of Smithfield, a bedroom community near Logan. Authorities say the two teenage boys accused of shooting Turner concocted the plan while playing video games and discussing their desire to “get rid” of the girl who was texting one of them.
